# Claims and evidence

*CC BY 4.0 · v0.3 · Every material claim the project makes, with its evidence and limits. Status: **Implemented** (code and passing tests), **Demonstrated** (reproducible run whose evidence is generated by a documented command), **Designed** (specified, not implemented), **Planned** (future milestone), **Blocked** (needs an external decision or input), **Unverified** (stated but not validated in this iteration). If a sentence in the README or the white paper is not covered here, treat it as unverified.*

Common commands: `T-py` = `cd tools && python -m pytest -q`; `T-sol` = `cd contracts && npx hardhat test`; `DEMO` = `./examples/e2e/run.sh`, which writes `evidence-manifest.json`. Baseline CI evidence for v0.3 is run [42642706736](https://github.com/xcapit/verifiable-policy-registry/actions/runs/42642706736); later runs on the PR supersede it.

## Policy registry and governance

| ID | Claim | Status | Evidence | Test or reproduction | Limitation | Owner / next |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C01 | Policy versions are append-only and every version expires within the scope's maximum validity | Implemented, Demonstrated | `VerifiablePolicyRegistry.publishPolicy`, `currentPolicy` | `T-sol` (expiry tests); `DEMO` stage "not in force after 90 days" | The resolver's behaviour on expiry depends on the charter and the sync daemon (Planned, VPR-015) | M. Nivoli |
| C02 | Only the governor publishes versions, rotates the governor and assigns issuer roles | Implemented | `onlyGovernor` | `T-sol` | The governor is expected to be a Safe; Safe configuration is out of scope of these tests | M. Nivoli |
| C03 | A scope can only be created by the governor it names | Implemented | `createScope` | `T-sol` | Names are not authenticated; discovery needs the manifest (Planned, VPR-049) | M. Nivoli |
| C04 | Appeals store only a document hash; rejection needs a reasoned-decision hash; a rejected document can be resubmitted | Implemented, Demonstrated | `fileAppeal`, `rejectAppeal`, `appealIdOf` | `T-sol`; `DEMO` appeal stages | Timeliness and fairness of decisions are institutional | Governor |
| C05 | One attestation role per address per scope, so the operator cannot also be the reviewer | Implemented | `setIssuer`, `issuerRole` | `T-sol` | EAS does not yet enforce roles; a schema resolver is Planned (VPR-012) | M. Nivoli |
| C06 | No single party can change a policy | Implemented (contract); Unverified (deployment) | Threshold enforced by the governor contract | `T-sol` covers the registry only | Depends on a correctly configured Safe with independent signers | Signers at Gate A |
| C07 | Expiry, published reasons and appeals make censorship visible and temporary | Implemented (mechanisms); Designed (charter, recourse) | Registry; [policy governance](GOVERNANCE.md) | `DEMO` | A colluding majority can still censor until expiry; no on-chain remedy ([threat model T16](security/THREAT_MODEL.md)) | Governor |
